item.title: [ENFORCEMENT] [Law Firm] When Competition Meets Consumer Protection: Europe’s Expanding Playbook on Algorithmic Pricing | Freshfields
item.description: Finally, competition authorities may take unlawful personalized pricing behavior under the General Data Protection Regulation (General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)) into account when establishing an abuse of dominance under Article 102 TFEU. Beyond classic antitrust enforcement, algorithmic pricing sits at the centre of a converging web of European digital, consumer, and data protection rules. Enforcers are no longer looking only at collusion or market power; they are policing the data inputs that fuel pricing engines and the consumer-facing tactics used to display those prices.

item.title: [ANALYSIS] [Publication] The global investigation maze: Key takeaways from Singapore - Lexology
item.description: These themes were explored at a closed-door discussion, the third in an ongoing series hosted by Withers KhattarWong in Singapore. Led by Shashi Nathan, white-collar crime partner and joint managing partner at Withers KhattarWong, the session brought together in-house counsel, compliance professionals, investigators, risk advisers and corporate leaders to exchange views on the practical realities of managing investigations in an increasingly international environment. Building on insights from previous discussions on anti-corruption and anti-money laundering compliance, this session focused on the challenges of navigating investigations that span borders, regulatory regimes and stakeholder groups.
